chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Isma'il ibn Mihran, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from his father and Husayn ibn Abi al-A'la, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

He said: When the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) is mentioned, increase your sending of blessings upon him. For whoever sends one blessing upon the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), Allah sends a thousand blessings upon him in a thousand rows of angels, and nothing from what Allah created remains except that it sends blessings upon the servant for the blessing of Allah upon him and the blessing of His angels upon him. Therefore, whoever does not desire this is ignorant and deceived. Allah has disavowed him, and His Messenger, and his Household.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for sending blessings upon the Prophet according to this hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (as) emphasizes the cosmic scale of Salawat, where a single invocation by the believer triggers a cascade of divine mercy involving thousands of angelic rows and all of creation. This multiplicative reward underscores the theological importance of maintaining a spiritual connection with the Prophet and his Household, serving as a litmus test for faith; those who neglect it are deemed 'ignorant and deceived' and subject to the disavowal of Allah, the Messenger, and the Ahl al-Bayt.
